gaussian-hmm.label: Supplied single-Gaussian character HMM
gaussian-hmm.runtime_scope: archived run; inference was not rerun on the pulled repository

scope.end_to_end: audio read, decode and resample through result serialization

configuration.model: single diagonal Gaussian per character state
configuration.whitespace_policy: supplied decoder collapses and strips whitespace

limitations: Supplied stage is named GMM-HMM but implements one Gaussian per character state
DCT of normalized log-Mel features is the supplied recipe, not standard MFCC computation
Infeasible training clips are explicitly counted; evaluation retains all frozen IDs
Gaussian quadratic expansion can introduce float32 rounding differences from the source difference tensor
No supported scored N-best; requested_n=0
Working minutes are not fully verified verbatim references

qwen_selection.criterion: minimum validation normalized CER, then normalized WER, then stable system key
qwen_selection.authority: project owner goal to audit and execute remaining B3 candidates

hardware_and_measurement_context.context_kind: supplemental host/method record before follow-up headline timing; per-repeat device telemetry stays in each timing export
hardware_and_measurement_context.storage_cache_condition: Local NTFS/NVMe files; OS caching enabled and not forcibly cleared. Full accuracy inference precedes the headline timed workload; a cold filesystem cache is not claimed.
hardware_and_measurement_context.concurrency: One controlled ASR timing job at a time after all project model downloads and GMM training finish; ordinary desktop processes are not controlled.

excluded: model/config loading and weight hash verification

reproduction_scope: Exact archived source and model packages are preserved separately; current repository code is authoritative. No removed implementation files are restored by this results import.
limitations: Working edited-minutes references, with 611 unreviewed and 25 historical single-reviewer test tags
Follow-up experiments after earlier working-test exposure; no blind preregistration claim
One training seed; speaker disjointness and complete pretraining-data separation are unproven
GMM-HMM uses graphemes, not a phoneme/pronunciation lexicon; classical results are weak
CPU/GPU timing rows use distinct devices; RTF is not a streaming guarantee
